# lukashechenberger.com

Lukas Hechenberger's website and blog. Next.js 16, Tailwind 4 and shadcn/ui in a Bun + Turborepo monorepo, deployed to Vercel.

```bash
bun install
bun run dev
```

See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the repository layout and checks, and [docs/blog-plan.md](docs/blog-plan.md) for the roadmap.
